spans.s: सोम (I) m. 1. Name of a plant used at sacrifices; 2. the juice of this plant, त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापाः Bg.ix.20; 3. nectar; 4. the moon; 5. water; 6. an epithet of Kubera; 7. an epithet of Yama, the god of death; 8. of Śiva; 9. air, wind; 10. camphor; 11. (as the last member of a compound) the best, chief.
सोम (II) n. 1. Rice-gruel; 2. the sky.
सोम-अभिषव m. the distilling of soma juice.
सोम-अह, -वार m. Monday.
सोम-अह, -वार m. Monday.
सोम-आख्य n. the red lotus.
सोम-उद्भवा f. the river Narmadā, (रेवा तु नर्मदा सोमोद्भवा मेखलकन्यका Am.i.10.32).
सोम-कांत m. the moon-gem.
सोम-क्षय m. disappearance of the moon.
सोम-ग्रह m. a vessel for taking up soma.
सोम-ज (I) a. moon-born.
सोम-ज (II) m. an epithet of the planet Mercury.
सोम-ज (III) n. milk.
सोम-धारा f. the sky, heaven.
सोम-नाथ m. 1. name of a celebrated Linga destroyed by Mahmud of Gazni in 1024 A.D. यः संतापं शिथिलमकरोत्सोमनाथं विलोक्य Vikr.Ch.xviii.97; 2. the place where this Linga was set up.
सोम-प m. 1. one who drinks the soma juice; 2. a soma sacrificer.
सोम-पा m. a drinker of soma.
सोम-पति m. an epithet of Indra.
सोम-पत्र n. a kind of grass.
सोम-पान n. the drinking of the soma juice.
सोम-पीथिन् m. a soma drinker, तत्र केचित्सोमपीथिन उदुंबरनामानो ब्रह्मवादिनः प्रतिवसंति स्म M.M.i.
सोम-प्रवाक m. a person commissioned to engage Śrotriyas for a soma sacrifice.
सोम-बंधु m. the white water-lily.
सोम-यज्ञ, -याग m. name of a sacrifice.
सोम-यज्ञ, -याग m. name of a sacrifice.
सोम-योनि m. a sort of yellow fragrant sandal.
सोम-रोग m. a particular disease to which women are liable.
सोम-लता, -वल्लरी f. 1. the soma plant; 2. name of the river Godāvarī.
सोम-लता, -वल्लरी f. 1. the soma plant; 2. name of the river Godāvarī.
सोम-वंश m. the lunar dynasty.
सोम-विक्रयिन् m. a vender of soma juice.
सोम-वृक्ष, -सार m. the white Khadira.
सोम-वृक्ष, -सार m. the white Khadira.
सोम-शकला f. a kind of cucumber.
सोम-संज्ञ n. camphor.
सोम-सद् m. a Pitṛ of a particular class, M.iii.195.
सोम-सिंधु m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
सोम-सुत् m. a soma-distiller.
सोम-सुता f. the river Narmadā.
सोम-सूत्र n. a channel for conveying water from a Śiva-linga.
सोम-सूत्र˚प्रदक्षिणा f. circumambulation around a Śiva-linga in such a way as that the somasūtra shall not be crossed.
सोमन् m. The moon.
सोमिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Performing the Soma sacrifice.
सोमिन् (II) m. A performer of Soma sacrifice.
सोमिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Performing the Soma sacrifice.
सोम्य a. (f. म्या) 1. Worthy of soma; 2. offering soma; 3. soft, good, amiable.
सोम्य a. (f. म्या) 1. Worthy of soma; 2. offering soma; 3. soft, good, amiable.
